orientation_or_instruction: Place only after the five escape vias below are filled and wicked flat. Match pin 1; solder all 20 leads without bridging them.
Match pin 1. All six leads are soldered, including the NC pin 4 land. Do not bridge neighboring pins.
Fit the 4 A fuse here. No polarity; do not replace it with a wire.
Fit the 0.5 A fan fuse here. No polarity; do not swap it with F1.
Back side of PCB. Cathode/band goes to pad 1, VMOT. Use the back assembly map; avoid reversing it.
18 actual 10 kOhm resistors. No polarity; ignore the number of spare resistors in the purchase bag.
Four actual 1 kOhm resistors. No polarity. R4 is a resistor; R5 is the link below.
Form a clipped tinned resistor lead across the two holes. It is a required wire link, not a 1 kOhm resistor.
Cathode/band goes to pad 1, VMOT. Leave body about 3-5 mm above the PCB; 25.4 mm formed lead spacing.
Cathode/band goes to pad 1, FAN_VMOT. This is the smaller fan-branch diode.
Two 100 nF ceramic capacitors; no polarity. Do not fit the electrolytics in these positions.
Five 100 uF / 35 V capacitors. Positive lead to pad 1/VMOT; striped negative side to pad 2/GND.
470 uF / 50 V bulk capacitor. Positive to pad 1/VMOT, striped negative to pad 2/GND. Keep body/leads clear of warm D1.
Solder TEN female 1x8 sockets here: two rows per module. Keep straight and fully seated. Do not solder five driver modules directly to the carrier.
Five four-position motor screw terminals. Fit each wire-entry side as shown on the front assembly map.
Fit the exact PJ-102AH barrel jack. Its shape/pad pattern determines orientation; do not substitute a similar-looking jack.
Two vertical two-pin male headers. J7 is HOLD. J9 is the mandatory RUN/GND harness. Neither is a motor-power connector.
Keyed four-pin PC fan header. The fan is pin 1 GND, pin 2 protected 12 V; pins 3/4 are unused.
Program the bare RP2040-Zero-M first. Then solder its 23 supplied male pins into the carrier. Pin 23 is electrically unused but still mechanically soldered. Do not connect motor power to it.
